main_body: stone tower building with conical green shingle roof
evidence: A pitched/conical roof slope acts as the visible upper surface in 3/4 view (rows 4-39, 36 rows tall), overhanging a brown trim/eave shadow (rows 40-41) and the vertical stone front wall (rows 42-94) with an inset window and arched door frame.

style.evidence: While the green roof has 5 shading steps and shingle pattern, the stone wall consists of large, uniform, completely flat rectangular blocks (~6x4 px each of a single flat colour per brightness zone) with zero internal grain or per-stone shading, unlike the intricately textured rubble stones and speckled plaster in the Beodeul reference houses.
